response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has strong technical skills and diverse experience, but lacks recent C++ experience (last significant C++ work was in 2015) and does not meet the 8+ year C++ experience threshold. His security expertise is not clearly demonstrated, and his background is heavily weighted toward web/mobile development rather than industrial automation or on-prem/cloud platform solutions. However, his architectural design, multi-threading, and performance optimization experience could be valuable if aligned with the role's requirements.
strengths: Strong background in high-performance, low-latency systems (e.g., DLang for data integration at Dunnhumby)
Proven architecture and design skills (e.g., GISCollective, event-driven platforms)
Experience with concurrent programming and scalable systems (e.g., micro-services at Dunnhumby, AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq)
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last significant role in 2015) and no clear evidence of C++11/14/17/20 usage
No demonstrated experience with industrial cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443) or secure development lifecycle (SDL)
Lacks direct experience in industrial automation, IoT, or on-prem/cloud platform solutions for automation machinery
